title: Attention Is All You Need
authors: Vaswani et al. (Google Brain / Google Research, 2017)
key_contribution: Introduced the Transformer architecture based entirely on multi-head self-attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence (RNNs) and convolutions entirely, establishing the foundation of modern LLMs.
legacy: Underpins GPT, Claude, Llama, BERT, Gemini, and modern generative AI.

title: In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm (Raft)
authors: Diego Ongaro and John Ousterhout (Stanford University, 2014)
key_contribution: Designed a distributed consensus algorithm equivalent to Paxos in fault tolerance and performance, but decomposed into independent subproblems (leader election, log replication, safety) to be fundamentally understandable.
legacy: Powers etcd (Kubernetes state store), CockroachDB, Consul, and modern cloud clustering.

title: Dynamo: Amazon's Highly Available Key-value Store
key_contribution: Synthesized consistent hashing, vector clocks, sloppy quorums, and anti-entropy Merkle trees to build an always-writable, eventually consistent distributed storage engine.
legacy: Sparked the NoSQL movement, directly inspiring Apache Cassandra and AWS DynamoDB.
